scrollContract: Content frames are named as native safe-area scroll content. Native implementation must scroll full content above stable system footer/tab safe areas; reference 844px viewport is not expanded for overflow. Paper normalized requested overflowY:auto to overflow:clip, so static drawing is not proof of scroll interaction.

exceptions.scope: Hidden coffee templates PS9-0, P8Y-0, PGL-0
exceptions.detail: Surface, radius, padding and minimum height updated while display:none was preserved. Paper drops inert flex gap/alignment and descendant flex-shrink/lane properties under hidden parents. These hidden layouts are not visually certified; apply the visible card contract when a real scroll/viewport state reveals them.
Existing content/form and settings-group masters inspected. Optional new master reference not added; no board created.
